same_original_domain.bandFloorProof: q<2^(-(ell0+4)) implies -log2(q)>ell0+4. Every active |ell+log2(q)|<3/4 therefore has ell>=ell0.
same_original_domain.compatibleAtlas: For any two prefix orders valid at this same q, every extra coefficient is exactly zero together with all derivatives. The backgrounds, phases, original matrices, Volterra solutions, H and fixed positive a coincide by ODE uniqueness. The actual monotone b_n>=2^n makes these prefix domains cover every q>0.
same_original_domain.exactPrefixProof: The actual common b_n is monotone. For n>=N+1, b_n*q>=1; the original time cutoff and all its derivatives are exactly zero, including at the flat endpoint.
same_original_domain.referenceChart: The original (R,Z,T), with T>=0, q=Q_ref*s>0 and 1/2<=s<=2.
